title: CRM Hygiene Sweep
one_line: Run a recurring cleanup on new and changed CRM records so the database stops degrading between audits.
description: Run a recurring cleanup on new and changed CRM records so the database stops degrading between audits. Use when someone wants ongoing data hygiene, has just finished a cleanup and wants it to hold, or needs a weekly CRM routine.
paragraph: A CRM cleaned once is dirty again in a quarter, because the intake keeps producing the same defects. This skill fixes the records that arrived since the last sweep, measures the drift rate, and points at the intake that caused it, so the sweep gets shorter over time instead of longer.
keywords: we cleaned it and it is dirty again
approval_stop: writing, merging, or deleting any CRM record

requirements.item: Read access to your CRM, or an export of the records
requirements.used_for: The records created or changed in the window

requirements_summary: Needs read access to your CRM, or an export of the records.
